component.name: TuxDirStat
component.summary: See what takes up space on your disks

description.p: TuxDirStat is a fast disk usage analyzer in the spirit of WinDirStat. It shows a folder tree sorted by size, a list of file types and a shaded treemap where every file is a box.

ul.li: Multithreaded scanning that handles millions of files
Groups the many small asset files of games into single boxes
Finds duplicate files by comparing their contents
Suggests caches, build output and other things that can be cleaned
Saves scans as snapshots (ncdu-compatible) and shows what changed since then
Searches by name, size, age, type and owner
Colors the treemap by file age, shows usage per owner and exports CSV
On Arch Linux, shows which package owns a file and lists files no package owns
Sunburst view, HTML reports and PNG images of the map
Scans other computers over SSH and records how folders grow week by week
On btrfs, shows how much data is shared with snapshots or stored compressed
Qt, GTK 3, GTK 4, Tk and terminal interfaces, light and dark themes, English and Turkish

description.p: TuxDirStat, WinDirStat tarzında hızlı bir disk kullanım analizörüdür. Boyuta göre sıralı klasör ağacını, dosya türü listesini ve her dosyanın bir kutu olduğu gölgeli treemap'i gösterir.

Sunburst view, scans over SSH, weekly size history, HTML reports and map images, installed packages and btrfs sharing views, a terminal interface, file manager menus, and translations in gettext .po files.

English interface (Turkish stays available), duplicate finder, cleanup suggestions, snapshots and comparison, search, age coloring, usage per owner, CSV export, pacman checks, administrator scans, an app icon, a man page and shell completions.
